purpose: Conditionally infer a uniform monthly selection rule from the user-designated 122 allocation labels.
scope: Long/cash, three equal allocations, month-end close, fixed units within month. No daily stops, leverage, date/security memorization, or change to the two-month momentum skip.
core_features: 6-, 9-, and 12-month momentum skipping 42 trading sessions; raw and risk adjusted.
side_features: 21/63/126-session volatility, 63-session downside volatility, industry-relative 60-session return, CMF21/63, 21/126 volume ratio, 252-session high proximity, 126-session moving-average distance.
normalization: Decision-date percentile ranks within the unchanged proxy universe; missing non-core inputs receive neutral median rank and remain counted in diagnostics.
models_before_testing: constrained pairwise Ridge: 50% positive momentum weights, 50% signed side-factor L1 budget
constrained pairwise Ridge: 60% positive momentum weights, 40% signed side-factor L1 budget
constrained pairwise Ridge: 80% positive momentum weights, 20% signed side-factor L1 budget
60/40 rule multiplied by 0.9 plus Ridge interaction correction clipped to +/-0.05
unconstrained Ridge on the same allowed inputs, diagnostic only because momentum dominance is not enforced
loss: Mean squared chosen-minus-unchosen score error against a common 0.10 ranking margin plus 0.001 L2 regularization; month-equal weighting. No parameter selection by return.
validation: Whole-sample explanatory fit and expanding prior-calendar-year fits from 2020. Report exact portfolios, overlap, selected-stock ranks, replay CAGR/Sharpe/drawdown, and image compatibility. Held-out labels are inferred from a full-history image and are not independent investment out-of-sample evidence.
protected: Do not alter original research, ledgers, plans, source hashes, or admission decisions. Do not change labels to improve rule fit.
